copy.headline: Taylor Swift Shares the Sweetest Moment With Her Niece After Travis Kelce Scores Epic Touchdown
copy.caption:
Taylor Swift and her niece Wyatt celebrated Travis Kelce's touchdown at the Kansas City Chiefs vs. Arizona Cardinals game in videos captured by fans. Taylor Swift is living the life of a showgirl auntie.

At the Kansas City Chiefs’ home game on Sunday (Nov. 22), the pop star exchanged an adorable moment with her eldest niece in the moments after Travis Kelce scored a major touchdown against the Arizona Cardinals. In clips from the broadcast captured and shared by fans online, Swift looks on from her suite at Arrowhead Stadium, watching the game with friends and family.
